findings.why: The only approval for BR-220 from Alluminio B (AP-0311) is for TO1 and STL series supply. The request is for service parts, which the approved source list excludes. The receiving plant is also not stated. No controlled record in the documents covers service-part approval for this part, plant and customer, so the absence cannot be read as 'not approved'. A person must confirm whether a service-part approval exists, for example under STL-CSR-SP-01, and which plant receives the parts.
